target_definition: Issuer Chapter 7/11 petition explicitly disclosed in primary SEC filings during the next calendar year, observed through the additional 200-day reporting window. Not exhaustive court coverage.
scope: Newer DEVELOPMENT study. Existing development companies may recur at a later date; this is not a fresh independent final cohort. All selected historical training IDs and reserved final IDs remain separated. Sampling is frozen before acquisition; missing sources/outcomes never become negatives.
evaluation: Compare frozen historical classifiers against a fixed set of classifiers refitted on expanded history using the same new cohort. Never compare a change of cohort to the earlier 303-company result as a clean model improvement. No final scoring or automatic production promotion.
